checkedAlternates.risk: Both Japanese stab binding and Smyth sewing use thread.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Japanese stab binding sews single leaves visibly through the outer margin (group-1), whereas Smyth sewing joins folded signatures internally inside a hardcover case (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: French flaps fold inward like a dust jacket.
checkedAlternates.resolution: French flaps are integral extensions of a softcover wrap (group-3), not a separate removable jacket over a rigid hardcover board (group-4).
